mechanism: Febuxostat inhibits xanthine oxidase and may have MAOI-like properties; combined with phenelzine (irreversible MAOI) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and cardiovascular complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if febuxostat is necessary, use alternative antidepressant or antihypertensive therapy; monitor blood pressure closely if combination unavoidable.
